message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: In 2014 July, a construction company and a contractor signed contract, later dispute, then a woodwork group (木工组) signed labor contract to complete unfinished work. On 2015-11-24, woodwork group workers, led by Chen2, blocked the project team from resuming work. A fight occurred; woodwork group worker Wang1 used a pry bar (撬棍) together with others to beat a worker Li (actually victim is 黎某某) on the head, causing heavy injury (重伤二级). So the crime is intentional injury (故意伤害) resulting in serious injury. Also there is a dispute over labor contract, but the main criminal act is assault causing serious injury. Possibly also "聚众扰乱社会秩序" if they blocked and caused disturbance? The examples: first example had similar scenario: "事实:公诉机关指控...被告人李某某持“顶托”将刘B打伤...刘A、刘B的伤势均已构成轻伤...". The answer: "故意伤害;聚众扰乱社会秩序". So they charged both intentional injury and disturbance of social order. In that case, there was a conflict between two parties, with many people. Here also there is a group of woodworkers blocking and fighting. Likely similar charges: 故意伤害;聚众扰乱社会秩序.

Check list: "聚众扰乱社会秩序" is present. So final answer: 故意伤害;聚众扰乱社会秩序.
